<?php

function pairKey(int $a, int $b): string
{
    return min($a, $b) . ':' . max($a, $b);
}

function mutexWithin(array $set, array $mutexes): bool
{
    $items = array_keys($set);
    foreach ($items as $i => $a)
        for ($j = $i + 1; $j < count($items); ++$j)
            if (isset($mutexes[pairKey($a, $items[$j])]))
                return true;
    return false;
}

function graphConflict(object $a, object $b, array $mutexes): bool
{
    if (
        array_intersect_key($a->delete, $b->pre + $b->add)
        || array_intersect_key($b->delete, $a->pre + $a->add)
    )
        return true;
    foreach ($a->pre as $p => $unused)
        foreach ($b->pre as $q => $unused)
            if (isset($mutexes[pairKey($p, $q)]))
                return true;
    return false;
}

final class PlanningGraph
{
    private array
        $facts,
        $factMutexes = [[]],
        $elements = [],
        $elementMutexes = [],
        $achievers = [],
        $memo = [],
        $lines = []
    ;
    private int $searched = 0, $memoHits = 0, $tried = 0;

    public function __construct(
        private array $actions,
        array $initial,
        private array $goal,
        private int $limit,
    ) {
        $this->facts = [$initial];
    }

    private function expand(int $level): void
    {
        $facts = $this->facts[$level];
        $mutexes = $this->factMutexes[$level];
        $elements = [];
        foreach ($this->actions as $a)
            if (subset($a->pre, $facts) && !mutexWithin($a->pre, $mutexes))
                $elements[] = $a;
        $count = count($elements);
        foreach (sortedKeys($facts) as $p)
            $elements[] = (object) [
                'number' => null,
                'pre' => [$p => true],
                'add' => [$p => true],
                'delete' => [],
            ];
        $exclusive = [];
        foreach ($elements as $i => $a)
            for ($j = $i + 1; $j < count($elements); ++$j)
                if (graphConflict($a, $elements[$j], $mutexes))
                    $exclusive[pairKey($i, $j)] = true;
        $this->lines[] =
            "action level $level: actions=$count noops=" . count($facts) . ' mutexes=' . count($exclusive);
        $achievers = [];
        foreach ($elements as $i => $a)
            foreach ($a->add as $p => $unused)
                $achievers[$p][] = $i;
        foreach ($achievers as &$producers)
            usort($producers, fn($a, $b) => ($elements[$a]->number ?? -1) <=> ($elements[$b]->number ?? -1));
        unset($producers);
        $next = array_fill_keys(array_keys($achievers), true);
        $nextMutexes = [];
        $keys = sortedKeys($next);
        foreach ($keys as $i => $p)
            for ($j = $i + 1; $j < count($keys); ++$j) {
                $q = $keys[$j];
                $all = true;
                foreach ($achievers[$p] as $a) {
                    foreach ($achievers[$q] as $b)
                        if ($a === $b || !isset($exclusive[pairKey($a, $b)])) {
                            $all = false;
                            break 2;
                        }
                }
                if ($all)
                    $nextMutexes[pairKey($p, $q)] = true;
            }
        $this->elements[] = $elements;
        $this->elementMutexes[] = $exclusive;
        $this->achievers[] = $achievers;
        $this->facts[] = $next;
        $this->factMutexes[] = $nextMutexes;
    }

    private function extract(int $level, array $goals): ?array
    {
        if ($level === 0)
            return [];
        $key = $level . ':' . implode(',', $goals);
        if (isset($this->memo[$key])) {
            ++$this->memoHits;
            return null;
        }
        ++$this->searched;
        $layers = $this->assign($level, $goals, 0, []);
        if ($layers === null)
            $this->memo[$key] = true;
        return $layers;
    }

    private function assign(int $level, array $goals, int $position, array $chosen): ?array
    {
        $elements = $this->elements[$level - 1];
        while (
            $position < count($goals)
            && array_any($chosen, fn($i) => isset($elements[$i]->add[$goals[$position]]))
        )
            ++$position;
        if ($position === count($goals)) {
            $previous = [];
            foreach ($chosen as $i)
                $previous += $elements[$i]->pre;
            $layers = $this->extract($level - 1, sortedKeys($previous));
            if ($layers === null)
                return null;
            $layer = [];
            foreach ($chosen as $i)
                if ($elements[$i]->number !== null)
                    $layer[] = $elements[$i]->number;
            sort($layer, SORT_NUMERIC);
            $layers[] = $layer;
            return $layers;
        }
        foreach ($this->achievers[$level - 1][$goals[$position]] as $i) {
            if (array_any($chosen, fn($j) => isset($this->elementMutexes[$level - 1][pairKey($i, $j)])))
                continue;
            ++$this->tried;
            $layers = $this->assign($level, $goals, $position + 1, [...$chosen, $i]);
            if ($layers !== null)
                return $layers;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function finish(string $status, array $layers = []): object
    {
        $plan = [];
        foreach ($layers as $layer)
            array_push($plan, ...$layer);
        return (object) [
            'status' => $status,
            'plan' => $plan,
            'layers' => $layers,
            'lines' => $this->lines,
            'expanded' => $this->searched,
            'generated' => $this->tried,
            'memoHits' => $this->memoHits,
        ];
    }

    public function run(): object
    {
        for ($level = 0; $level <= $this->limit; ++$level) {
            $facts = $this->facts[$level];
            $mutexes = $this->factMutexes[$level];
            $this->lines[] = "fact level $level: facts=" . count($facts) . ' mutexes=' . count($mutexes);
            $possible = subset($this->goal, $facts) && !mutexWithin($this->goal, $mutexes);
            if ($possible) {
                $before = $this->searched;
                $hits = $this->memoHits;
                $layers = $this->extract($level, sortedKeys($this->goal));
                $this->lines[] =
                    "extract level $level: "
                    . ($layers !== null ? 'success' : 'fail')
                    . ' searched='
                    . ($this->searched - $before)
                    . ' memo_hits='
                    . ($this->memoHits - $hits);
                if ($layers !== null)
                    return $this->finish('solved', $layers);
            } elseif (
                $level > 0
                && count($facts) === count($this->facts[$level - 1])
                && count($mutexes) === count($this->factMutexes[$level - 1])
            )
                return $this->finish('unreachable');
            if ($level === $this->limit)
                return $this->finish('level limit');
            $this->expand($level);
        }
        throw new LogicException('Missing graph level');
    }
}

<?php

function subtype(array $parents, string $actual, string $expected): bool
{
    while ($actual !== null) {
        if ($actual === $expected)
            return true;
        $actual = $parents[$actual];
    }
    return false;
}

function notation(array $atom): string
{
    return '(' . implode(' ', [$atom[0], ...$atom[1]]) . ')';
}

function substitute(array $atom, array $binding): array
{
    return [$atom[0], array_map(fn($term) => $binding[$term], $atom[1])];
}

function subset(array $a, array $b): bool
{
    return !array_diff_key($a, $b);
}

function sortedKeys(array $set): array
{
    $keys = array_keys($set);
    sort($keys, SORT_NUMERIC);
    return $keys;
}

function sequenceCompare(array $a, array $b): int
{
    for ($i = 0; $i < min(count($a), count($b)); ++$i)
        if ($a[$i] !== $b[$i])
            return $a[$i] <=> $b[$i];
    return count($a) <=> count($b);
}

function ground(object $d, object $problem): object
{
    $objectsByType = [];
    foreach ($d->typeOrder as $kind)
        $objectsByType[$kind] = array_keys(array_filter($problem->objects, fn($actual) => subtype(
            $d->parents,
            $actual,
            $kind,
        )));
    $initialAtoms = [];
    $atomByKey = [];
    foreach ($problem->initial as $a) {
        $key = notation($a);
        $initialAtoms[$key] = true;
        $atomByKey[$key] = $a;
    }
    $candidates = $statistics = [];
    foreach ($d->actions as $schema) {
        $choices = array_map(fn($p) => $objectsByType[$p[1]], $schema->parameters);
        $assignments = 1;
        foreach ($choices as $choice)
            $assignments *= count($choice);
        $statistics[$schema->name] = [$assignments, 0, 0];
        $enumerate = function (int $i, array $args) use (
            &$enumerate,
            $choices,
            $schema,
            $d,
            $initialAtoms,
            &$candidates,
            &$statistics,
            &$atomByKey,
        ): void {
            if ($i < count($choices)) {
                foreach ($choices[$i] as $object)
                    $enumerate($i + 1, [...$args, $object]);
                return;
            }
            $binding = array_combine(array_column($schema->parameters, 0), $args);
            $pre = $neg = $add = $delete = [];
            foreach ($schema->condition as [$sign, $a]) {
                $bound = substitute($a, $binding);
                $key = notation($bound);
                $atomByKey[$key] = $bound;
                if ($bound[0] === '=')
                    $truth = $bound[1][0] === $bound[1][1];
                elseif (isset($d->static[$bound[0]]))
                    $truth = isset($initialAtoms[$key]);
                else {
                    if ($sign)
                        $pre[$key] = true;
                    else
                        $neg[$key] = true;
                    continue;
                }
                if ($truth !== $sign)
                    return;
            }
            foreach ($schema->effects as [$sign, $a]) {
                $bound = substitute($a, $binding);
                $key = notation($bound);
                $atomByKey[$key] = $bound;
                if ($sign)
                    $add[$key] = true;
                else
                    $delete[$key] = true;
            }
            $delete = array_diff_key($delete, $add);
            $candidates[] = (object) [
                'source' => $schema,
                'arguments' => $args,
                'cost' => $schema->cost,
                'pre' => $pre,
                'neg' => $neg,
                'add' => $add,
                'delete' => $delete,
            ];
            ++$statistics[$schema->name][1];
        };
        $enumerate(0, []);
    }
    $reachable = [];
    foreach ($problem->initial as $a)
        if (isset($d->fluent[$a[0]]))
            $reachable[notation($a)] = true;
    $accepted = [];
    do {
        $changed = false;
        foreach ($candidates as $i => $a)
            if (!isset($accepted[$i]) && subset($a->pre, $reachable)) {
                $accepted[$i] = true;
                $reachable += $a->add;
                ++$statistics[$a->source->name][2];
                $changed = true;
            }
    } while ($changed);
    $predicateOrder = array_flip(array_keys($d->predicates));
    $objectOrder = array_flip(array_keys($problem->objects));
    $factKeys = array_keys($reachable);
    usort($factKeys, function ($a, $b) use ($atomByKey, $predicateOrder, $objectOrder) {
        $x = $atomByKey[$a];
        $y = $atomByKey[$b];
        return (
            $predicateOrder[$x[0]] <=> $predicateOrder[$y[0]] ?: sequenceCompare(
                array_map(fn($n) => $objectOrder[$n], $x[1]),
                array_map(fn($n) => $objectOrder[$n], $y[1]),
            )
        );
    });
    $facts = array_map(fn($key) => $atomByKey[$key], $factKeys);
    $factNumbers = array_flip($factKeys);
    $actions = $actionNumbers = [];
    foreach ($candidates as $i => $candidate)
        if (isset($accepted[$i])) {
            $a = (object) [
                'number' => count($actions),
                'source' => $candidate->source,
                'arguments' => $candidate->arguments,
                'cost' => $candidate->cost,
            ];
            foreach (['pre', 'neg', 'add', 'delete'] as $field) {
                $mapped = [];
                foreach ($candidate->$field as $key => $unused)
                    if (isset($factNumbers[$key]))
                        $mapped[$factNumbers[$key]] = true;
                $a->$field = $mapped;
            }
            $actions[] = $a;
            $actionNumbers[notation([$a->source->name, $a->arguments])] = $a->number;
        }
    $initial = $goal = $unreachable = [];
    $staticCount = 0;
    foreach ($problem->initial as $a) {
        if (isset($d->fluent[$a[0]]))
            $initial[$factNumbers[notation($a)]] = true;
        else
            ++$staticCount;
    }
    foreach ($problem->goals as $a) {
        $key = notation($a);
        if (isset($factNumbers[$key]))
            $goal[$factNumbers[$key]] = true;
        elseif (!isset($d->static[$a[0]]) || !isset($initialAtoms[$key]))
            $unreachable[] = $a;
    }
    return (object) [
        'name' => $problem->name,
        'source' => $problem,
        'objectsByType' => $objectsByType,
        'statistics' => $statistics,
        'candidateCount' => count($candidates),
        'facts' => $facts,
        'actions' => $actions,
        'initial' => $initial,
        'goal' => $goal,
        'unreachable' => $unreachable,
        'staticCount' => $staticCount,
        'actionNumbers' => $actionNumbers,
    ];
}

<?php

const HEURISTICS = ['goalcount', 'hmax', 'hadd', 'ff', 'lmcount'];

final class Heuristics
{
    private array $achievers, $cache = [];

    public function __construct(
        private object $problem,
    ) {
        $this->achievers = array_fill(0, count($problem->facts), []);
        foreach ($problem->actions as $a)
            foreach ($a->add as $p => $unused)
                $this->achievers[$p][] = $a->number;
    }

    private function key(array $state): string
    {
        return implode(',', sortedKeys($state));
    }

    public function relaxedCosts(array $state, bool $maximum): array
    {
        $key = ($maximum ? 'max:' : 'add:') . $this->key($state);
        if (isset($this->cache[$key]))
            return $this->cache[$key];
        $costs = array_fill(0, count($this->problem->facts), null);
        foreach ($state as $p => $unused)
            $costs[$p] = 0;
        do {
            $changed = false;
            foreach ($this->problem->actions as $a) {
                $values = [];
                foreach ($a->pre as $p => $unused)
                    $values[] = $costs[$p];
                if (in_array(null, $values, true))
                    continue;
                $value = $a->cost + ($maximum ? ($values ? max($values) : 0) : array_sum($values));
                foreach ($a->add as $p => $unused)
                    if ($costs[$p] === null || $value < $costs[$p]) {
                        $costs[$p] = $value;
                        $changed = true;
                    }
            }
        } while ($changed);
        return $this->cache[$key] = $costs;
    }

    public function relaxedPlan(array $state): ?array
    {
        $key = 'plan:' . $this->key($state);
        if (array_key_exists($key, $this->cache))
            return $this->cache[$key];
        $costs = $this->relaxedCosts($state, false);
        foreach ($this->problem->goal as $p => $unused)
            if ($costs[$p] === null)
                return $this->cache[$key] = null;
        $chosen = [];
        $pending = array_keys(array_diff_key($this->problem->goal, $state));
        while ($pending) {
            $p = array_pop($pending);
            $winner = $lowest = null;
            foreach ($this->achievers[$p] as $n) {
                $a = $this->problem->actions[$n];
                $values = [];
                foreach ($a->pre as $q => $unused)
                    $values[] = $costs[$q];
                if (in_array(null, $values, true))
                    continue;
                $cost = $a->cost + array_sum($values);
                if ($lowest === null || $cost < $lowest) {
                    $lowest = $cost;
                    $winner = $n;
                }
            }
            if (!isset($chosen[$winner])) {
                $chosen[$winner] = true;
                array_push(
                    $pending,
                    ...array_keys(array_diff_key($this->problem->actions[$winner]->pre, $state)),
                );
            }
        }
        return $this->cache[$key] = sortedKeys($chosen);
    }

    public function helpful(array $state): array
    {
        $plan = $this->relaxedPlan($state);
        return (
            $plan === null
                ? []
                : array_values(array_filter($plan, fn($n) => applicable($this->problem->actions[$n], $state)))
        );
    }

    private function levels(array $state): array
    {
        $facts = array_fill(0, count($this->problem->facts), null);
        foreach ($state as $p => $unused)
            $facts[$p] = 0;
        $actions = array_fill(0, count($this->problem->actions), null);
        $level = 0;
        do {
            $changed = false;
            foreach ($this->problem->actions as $a) {
                if ($actions[$a->number] !== null)
                    continue;
                $ready = true;
                foreach ($a->pre as $p => $unused)
                    if ($facts[$p] === null || $facts[$p] > $level) {
                        $ready = false;
                        break;
                    }
                if (!$ready)
                    continue;
                $actions[$a->number] = $level;
                foreach ($a->add as $p => $unused)
                    if ($facts[$p] === null) {
                        $facts[$p] = $level + 1;
                        $changed = true;
                    }
            }
            ++$level;
        } while ($changed);
        return [$facts, $actions];
    }

    private function verified(array $state, int $excluded): bool
    {
        $reachable = $state;
        $omit = array_fill_keys($this->achievers[$excluded], true);
        do {
            $changed = false;
            foreach ($this->problem->actions as $a)
                if (!isset($omit[$a->number]) && subset($a->pre, $reachable)) {
                    $new = array_diff_key($a->add, $reachable);
                    if ($new) {
                        $reachable += $new;
                        $changed = true;
                    }
                }
        } while ($changed);
        return !subset($this->problem->goal, $reachable);
    }

    public function landmarks(array $state): ?array
    {
        $key = 'lm:' . $this->key($state);
        if (array_key_exists($key, $this->cache))
            return $this->cache[$key];
        [$fl, $al] = $this->levels($state);
        foreach ($this->problem->goal as $p => $unused)
            if ($fl[$p] === null)
                return $this->cache[$key] = null;
        $landmarks = array_diff_key($this->problem->goal, $state);
        $pending = sortedKeys($landmarks);
        $verified = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($pending); ++$i) {
            $p = $pending[$i];
            $candidates = null;
            foreach ($this->achievers[$p] as $n)
                if ($al[$n] === ($fl[$p] - 1))
                    $candidates = $candidates === null
                        ? $this->problem->actions[$n]->pre
                        : array_intersect_key($candidates, $this->problem->actions[$n]->pre);
            foreach (sortedKeys(array_diff_key($candidates ?? [], $state, $landmarks)) as $q) {
                if (!array_key_exists($q, $verified))
                    $verified[$q] = $this->verified($state, $q);
                if ($verified[$q]) {
                    $landmarks[$q] = true;
                    $pending[] = $q;
                }
            }
        }
        return $this->cache[$key] = $landmarks;
    }

    public function value(string $name, array $state): ?int
    {
        if ($name === 'none')
            return 0;
        if ($name === 'goalcount')
            return count(array_diff_key($this->problem->goal, $state));
        if ($name === 'hmax' || $name === 'hadd') {
            $costs = $this->relaxedCosts($state, $name === 'hmax');
            $values = [];
            foreach ($this->problem->goal as $p => $unused)
                $values[] = $costs[$p];
            if (in_array(null, $values, true))
                return null;
            return $name === 'hmax' ? ($values ? max($values) : 0) : array_sum($values);
        }
        if ($name === 'ff') {
            $plan = $this->relaxedPlan($state);
            return $plan === null
                ? null
                : array_sum(array_map(fn($n) => $this->problem->actions[$n]->cost, $plan));
        }
        $lm = $this->landmarks($state);
        return $lm === null ? null : count($lm);
    }

    public function values(array $state): array
    {
        $values = [];
        foreach (HEURISTICS as $name)
            $values[$name] = $this->value($name, $state);
        return $values;
    }
}

<?php

foreach (['pddl_parser', 'grounding', 'heuristics', 'search', 'graphplan'] as $module)
    require_once __DIR__ . "/$module.php";
function actionText(object $a): string
{
    return notation([$a->source->name, $a->arguments]);
}

function numberList(array $set): string
{
    $keys = sortedKeys($set);
    return $keys ? implode(',', $keys) : '-';
}

function headed(string $heading, array $items): string
{
    return $heading . ' ' . ($items ? implode(' ', $items) : '-');
}

function valueText(?int $v): string
{
    return $v === null ? 'inf' : (string) $v;
}

function heuristicText(array $values): string
{
    $parts = [];
    foreach (HEURISTICS as $name)
        $parts[] = $name . '=' . valueText($values[$name]);
    return implode(' ', $parts);
}

function inputLines(string $name): array
{
    return array_values(array_filter(
        file('input/' . $name, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES),
        fn($line) => $line !== '' && $line[0] !== '#',
    ));
}

function readSettings(): array
{
    $settings = ['runs' => []];
    foreach (inputLines('params.txt') as $line) {
        $f = explode(' ', $line);
        if ($f[0] === 'run')
            $settings['runs'][] = array_slice($f, 1);
        elseif ($f[0] === 'repair')
            $settings['repair'] = array_slice($f, 1);
        else
            $settings[$f[0]] = (int) $f[1];
    }
    return $settings;
}

function readCandidates(): array
{
    $candidates = [];
    $current = null;
    foreach (inputLines('candidates.txt') as $line) {
        if (str_starts_with($line, 'plan ')) {
            [, $problem, $label] = explode(' ', $line);
            $current = (object) [
                'number' => count($candidates) + 1,
                'problem' => $problem,
                'label' => $label,
                'steps' => [],
            ];
        } elseif ($line === 'end')
            $candidates[] = $current;
        else {
            $f = explode(' ', substr($line, 1, -1));
            $current->steps[] = [$f[0], array_slice($f, 1)];
        }
    }
    return $candidates;
}

function argumentError(object $d, array $arguments, array $expected, array $table, string $noun): ?string
{
    if (count($arguments) !== count($expected))
        return 'expected ' . count($expected) . ' arguments, got ' . count($arguments);
    foreach ($arguments as $i => $argument) {
        if (!isset($table[$argument]))
            return "unknown $noun $argument";
        if (!subtype($d->parents, $table[$argument], $expected[$i]))
            return 'argument ' . ($i + 1) . " ($argument) is not of type {$expected[$i]}";
    }
    return null;
}

function validateDomain(object $d): void
{
    $kept = $diagnostics = [];
    foreach ($d->actions as $a) {
        $error = null;
        foreach ($a->parameters as [$name, $kind])
            if (!array_key_exists($kind, $d->parents)) {
                $error = 'unknown type ' . $kind;
                break;
            }
        if ($error === null) {
            $parameters = [];
            foreach ($a->parameters as [$name, $kind])
                $parameters[$name] = $kind;
            foreach ([...$a->condition, ...$a->effects] as [$sign, $atom]) {
                if ($atom[0] !== '=' && !isset($d->predicates[$atom[0]]))
                    $error = 'unknown predicate ' . $atom[0];
                else
                    $error = argumentError(
                        $d,
                        $atom[1],
                        $atom[0] === '=' ? ['object', 'object'] : $d->predicates[$atom[0]],
                        $parameters,
                        'variable',
                    );
                if ($error !== null) {
                    $error = notation($atom) . ': ' . $error;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if ($error === null)
            $kept[] = $a;
        else
            $diagnostics[] = "error: action {$a->name}: $error";
    }
    $d->actions = $kept;
    $d->byName = $d->fluent = [];
    $used = [];
    foreach ($kept as $a) {
        $d->byName[$a->name] = $a;
        foreach ([...$a->condition, ...$a->effects] as [$sign, $atom])
            $used[$atom[0]] = true;
        foreach ($a->effects as [$sign, $atom])
            $d->fluent[$atom[0]] = true;
    }
    foreach ($d->predicates as $predicate => $unused)
        if (!isset($used[$predicate]))
            $diagnostics[] = "warning: predicate $predicate is not used by any action";
    $d->static = array_diff_key($d->predicates, $d->fluent);
    $d->diagnostics = $diagnostics;
}

function validateProblem(object $d, object $p): void
{
    $diagnostics = [];
    foreach (['init' => 'initial', 'goal' => 'goals'] as $side => $field) {
        $kept = $seen = [];
        foreach ($p->$field as $atom) {
            $error = !isset($d->predicates[$atom[0]])
                ? 'unknown predicate ' . $atom[0]
                : argumentError($d, $atom[1], $d->predicates[$atom[0]], $p->objects, 'object');
            $key = notation($atom);
            if ($error === null && isset($seen[$key]))
                $error = 'duplicate';
            if ($error === null) {
                $kept[] = $atom;
                $seen[$key] = true;
            } else
                $diagnostics[] = "warning: $side $key: $error";
        }
        $p->$field = $kept;
    }
    $p->diagnostics = $diagnostics;
}

function validationResult(string $status, array $messages, int $correct): object
{
    return (object) ['status' => $status, 'messages' => $messages, 'correct' => $correct];
}

function validateSteps(object $d, object $p, array $steps): object
{
    $world = [];
    foreach ($p->initial as $a)
        $world[notation($a)] = true;
    $cost = 0;
    foreach ($steps as $i => [$name, $arguments]) {
        $position = $i + 1;
        $heading = "step $position " . notation([$name, $arguments]) . ': ';
        if (!isset($d->byName[$name]))
            return validationResult('invalid', [$heading . 'unknown action ' . $name], $i);
        $schema = $d->byName[$name];
        $error = argumentError($d, $arguments, array_column($schema->parameters, 1), $p->objects, 'object');
        if ($error !== null)
            return validationResult('invalid', [$heading . $error], $i);
        $binding = array_combine(array_column($schema->parameters, 0), $arguments);
        foreach ($schema->condition as [$sign, $atom]) {
            $bound = substitute($atom, $binding);
            $text = notation($bound);
            $truth = $bound[0] === '=' ? $bound[1][0] === $bound[1][1] : isset($world[$text]);
            if ($truth !== $sign) {
                $literal = $sign ? $text : '(not ' . $text . ')';
                return validationResult('invalid', [$heading . 'precondition ' . $literal . ' is false'], $i);
            }
        }
        foreach ($schema->effects as [$sign, $atom])
            if (!$sign)
                unset($world[notation(substitute($atom, $binding))]);
        foreach ($schema->effects as [$sign, $atom])
            if ($sign)
                $world[notation(substitute($atom, $binding))] = true;
        $cost += $schema->cost;
    }
    $missing = [];
    foreach ($p->goals as $atom)
        if (!isset($world[notation($atom)]))
            $missing[] = 'unsatisfied goal ' . notation($atom);
    return (
        $missing
            ? validationResult('goal not reached', $missing, count($steps))
            : validationResult('valid', ['length=' . count($steps) . " cost=$cost"], count($steps))
    );
}

function verdict(object $v): string
{
    return $v->status . ($v->status === 'valid' ? ' ' : ': ') . $v->messages[0];
}

function planSteps(object $p, array $plan): array
{
    return array_map(fn($n) => [$p->actions[$n]->source->name, $p->actions[$n]->arguments], $plan);
}

function planCost(object $p, array $plan): int
{
    return array_sum(array_map(fn($n) => $p->actions[$n]->cost, $plan));
}

function interferes(object $a, object $b): bool
{
    return (bool) (
        array_intersect_key($a->delete, $b->pre + $b->add)
        || array_intersect_key($b->delete, $a->pre + $a->add)
        || array_intersect_key($a->add, $b->neg)
        || array_intersect_key($b->add, $a->neg)
    );
}

function parallelize(object $p, array $plan): array
{
    $assigned = $layers = [];
    foreach ($plan as $i => $number) {
        $a = $p->actions[$number];
        $layer = 1;
        for ($j = 0; $j < $i; ++$j) {
            $b = $p->actions[$plan[$j]];
            if (
                array_intersect_key($b->add, $a->pre)
                || array_intersect_key($b->delete, $a->neg)
                || interferes($b, $a)
            )
                $layer = max($layer, $assigned[$j] + 1);
        }
        $assigned[] = $layer;
        while (count($layers) < $layer)
            $layers[] = [];
        $layers[$layer - 1][] = $number;
    }
    return $layers;
}

function validateParallel(object $p, array $layers): string
{
    $state = $p->initial;
    foreach ($layers as $i => $layer) {
        $actions = array_map(fn($n) => $p->actions[$n], $layer);
        foreach ($actions as $j => $a) {
            if (!applicable($a, $state))
                return 'invalid at layer ' . ($i + 1);
            for ($k = $j + 1; $k < count($actions); ++$k)
                if (interferes($a, $actions[$k]))
                    return 'invalid at layer ' . ($i + 1);
        }
        $delete = $add = [];
        foreach ($actions as $a) {
            $delete += $a->delete;
            $add += $a->add;
        }
        $state = array_diff_key($state, $delete) + $add;
    }
    return subset($p->goal, $state) ? 'valid' : 'goal not reached';
}

function improve(object $p, array $plan): array
{
    $i = 0;
    while ($i < count($plan)) {
        $state = $p->initial;
        foreach (array_slice($plan, 0, $i) as $n)
            $state = applyAction($p->actions[$n], $state);
        $applied = [];
        foreach (array_slice($plan, $i + 1) as $n)
            if (applicable($p->actions[$n], $state)) {
                $state = applyAction($p->actions[$n], $state);
                $applied[] = $n;
            }
        if (subset($p->goal, $state))
            $plan = [...array_slice($plan, 0, $i), ...$applied];
        else
            ++$i;
    }
    return $plan;
}

function transformNegatives(object $p): array
{
    $negative = [];
    foreach ($p->actions as $a)
        $negative += $a->neg;
    $complements = [];
    foreach (sortedKeys($negative) as $i => $fact)
        $complements[$fact] = count($p->facts) + $i;
    $actions = [];
    foreach ($p->actions as $a) {
        $pre = $a->pre;
        $add = $a->add;
        $delete = $a->delete;
        foreach ($a->neg as $f => $unused)
            $pre[$complements[$f]] = true;
        foreach ($a->delete as $f => $unused)
            if (isset($complements[$f]))
                $add[$complements[$f]] = true;
        foreach ($a->add as $f => $unused)
            if (isset($complements[$f]))
                $delete[$complements[$f]] = true;
        $actions[] = (object) ['number' => $a->number, 'pre' => $pre, 'add' => $add, 'delete' => $delete];
    }
    $initial = $p->initial;
    foreach ($complements as $f => $c)
        if (!isset($initial[$f]))
            $initial[$c] = true;
    return [$actions, $initial, count($complements)];
}

final class Planner
{
    private object $domain;
    private array
        $sources,
        $settings,
        $candidates,
        $tags,
        $totals,
        $grounding = [],
        $plans = [],
        $graph = [],
        $validation = [],
        $comparison = ['problem,algorithm,heuristic,length,cost,expanded,generated'],
        $problems = [],
        $evaluators = [],
        $summaries = []
    ;
    private int $validatedPlans = 0, $validPlans = 0, $validCandidates = 0;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->domain = readDomain(file_get_contents('input/domain.txt'));
        $this->sources = readProblems(file_get_contents('input/problems.txt'));
        $this->settings = readSettings();
        $this->candidates = readCandidates();
        validateDomain($this->domain);
        $this->tags = array_map(fn($pair) => implode(' ', $pair), $this->settings['runs']);
        $this->tags[] = 'graphplan';
        $this->totals = array_fill(0, count($this->tags), [
            'solved' => 0,
            'best' => 0,
            'expanded' => 0,
            'generated' => 0,
        ]);
    }

    private function domainReport(): void
    {
        $d = $this->domain;
        $this->grounding = ["== domain {$d->name} ==", ...$d->diagnostics];
        foreach ($d->typeOrder as $kind) {
            $chain = [];
            $current = $kind;
            while ($current !== null) {
                $chain[] = $current;
                $current = $d->parents[$current];
            }
            $this->grounding[] = 'type ' . implode(' < ', $chain);
        }
        foreach ($d->predicates as $name => $types)
            $this->grounding[] =
                "predicate $name/" . count($types) . ' ' . (isset($d->fluent[$name]) ? 'fluent' : 'static');
        foreach ($d->actions as $a) {
            $adds = count(array_filter($a->effects, fn($l) => $l[0]));
            $deletes = count($a->effects) - $adds;
            $this->grounding[] =
                "action {$a->name}/"
                . count($a->parameters)
                . " cost={$a->cost} pre="
                . count($a->condition)
                . " add=$adds del=$deletes";
        }
    }

    private function groundingReport(object $p): void
    {
        array_push($this->grounding, '', "== problem {$p->name} ==", ...$p->source->diagnostics);
        $this->grounding[] = 'objects: ' . count($p->source->objects);
        foreach ($this->domain->typeOrder as $type)
            $this->grounding[] = headed("  $type:", $p->objectsByType[$type]);
        $this->grounding[] = 'static facts: ' . $p->staticCount;
        foreach ($this->domain->actions as $a) {
            [$assignments, $candidates, $reachable] = $p->statistics[$a->name];
            $this->grounding[] = "schema {$a->name}: assignments=$assignments candidates=$candidates reachable=$reachable";
        }
        $this->grounding[] = "candidates: {$p->candidateCount} reachable: " . count($p->actions);
        $this->grounding[] =
            'facts: ' . count($p->facts) . ' init: ' . count($p->initial) . ' goals: ' . count($p->goal);
        foreach ($p->unreachable as $atom)
            $this->grounding[] = 'unreachable goal: ' . notation($atom);
        $counts = [];
        foreach ($p->facts as $atom)
            $counts[$atom[0]] = ($counts[$atom[0]] ?? 0) + 1;
        $items = [];
        foreach ($this->domain->predicates as $name => $unused)
            if (isset($this->domain->fluent[$name]))
                $items[] = $name . '=' . ($counts[$name] ?? 0);
        $this->grounding[] = headed('facts by predicate:', $items);
        $this->grounding[] = 'facts:';
        foreach ($p->facts as $n => $atom)
            $this->grounding[] = "  $n " . notation($atom);
        $this->grounding[] = 'actions:';
        foreach ($p->actions as $a)
            $this->grounding[] =
                "  {$a->number} "
                . actionText($a)
                . " cost={$a->cost} pre="
                . numberList($a->pre)
                . ' neg='
                . numberList($a->neg)
                . ' add='
                . numberList($a->add)
                . ' del='
                . numberList($a->delete);
    }

    private function initialReport(object $p, Heuristics $e): array
    {
        $values = $e->values($p->initial);
        $landmarks = $e->landmarks($p->initial) ?? [];
        $relaxed = $e->relaxedPlan($p->initial) ?? [];
        $this->plans[] = 'initial h: ' . heuristicText($values);
        $this->plans[] = 'landmarks: ' . count($landmarks);
        foreach (sortedKeys($landmarks) as $n)
            $this->plans[] = '  ' . notation($p->facts[$n]);
        $this->plans[] = 'relaxed plan: length=' . count($relaxed) . ' cost=' . valueText($values['ff']);
        foreach ($relaxed as $n)
            $this->plans[] = '  ' . actionText($p->actions[$n]);
        $this->plans[] = headed('helpful:', array_map(fn($n) => actionText(
            $p->actions[$n],
        ), $e->helpful($p->initial)));
        return $landmarks;
    }

    private function planReport(object $p, string $tag, array $plan, array $landmarks, array &$earlier): void
    {
        $cost = planCost($p, $plan);
        $key = implode(',', $plan);
        $first = $earlier[$key] ??= $tag;
        $this->plans[] =
            'plan: length='
            . count($plan)
            . " cost=$cost"
            . ($first !== $tag ? ' (same as ' . $first . ')' : '');
        $counts = [];
        foreach ($plan as $i => $n) {
            $a = $p->actions[$n];
            $this->plans[] = '  ' . ($i + 1) . ' ' . actionText($a);
            $counts[$a->source->name] = ($counts[$a->source->name] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
        $items = [];
        foreach ($this->domain->actions as $a)
            if ($counts[$a->name] ?? 0)
                $items[] = $a->name . '=' . $counts[$a->name];
        $this->plans[] = headed('schemas:', $items);
        $layers = parallelize($p, $plan);
        $this->plans[] = 'parallel: layers=' . count($layers);
        foreach ($layers as $i => $layer)
            $this->plans[] = headed('  ' . ($i + 1) . ':', array_map(fn($n) => actionText(
                $p->actions[$n],
            ), $layer));
        $improved = improve($p, $plan);
        $removed = count($plan) - count($improved);
        $this->plans[] =
            'improved: length=' . count($improved) . ' cost=' . planCost($p, $improved) . " removed=$removed";
        if ($removed)
            foreach ($improved as $i => $n)
                $this->plans[] = '  ' . ($i + 1) . ' ' . actionText($p->actions[$n]);
        $state = $p->initial;
        $reached = [];
        foreach ($plan as $n) {
            $state = applyAction($p->actions[$n], $state);
            $reached += array_intersect_key($state, $landmarks);
        }
        $this->plans[] = 'landmarks reached: ' . count($reached) . '/' . count($landmarks);
        foreach (sortedKeys(array_diff_key($landmarks, $reached)) as $n)
            $this->plans[] = '  missed ' . notation($p->facts[$n]);
        $v = validateSteps($this->domain, $p->source, planSteps($p, $plan));
        $vi = validateSteps($this->domain, $p->source, planSteps($p, $improved));
        $this->validation[] = $tag . ': ' . verdict($v);
        $this->validation[] = '  parallel: ' . validateParallel($p, $layers);
        $this->validation[] = '  improved: ' . verdict($vi);
        ++$this->validatedPlans;
        $this->validPlans += (int) ($v->status === 'valid');
    }

    private function resultReport(
        object $p,
        string $tag,
        object $result,
        array $landmarks,
        array &$earlier,
    ): void {
        $this->plans[] = "-- $tag --";
        if ($p->unreachable) {
            $this->plans[] = 'result: FAIL (unreachable goal)';
            return;
        }
        $state = $result->status === 'solved' ? 'solved' : 'FAIL (' . $result->status . ')';
        $this->plans[] = "result: $state expanded={$result->expanded} generated={$result->generated}";
        if ($result->status === 'solved')
            $this->planReport($p, $tag, $result->plan, $landmarks, $earlier);
    }

    private function graphReport(object $p, object $result, int $complements): void
    {
        if ($p->unreachable) {
            $this->graph[] = 'result: FAIL (unreachable goal)';
            return;
        }
        $this->graph[] = 'complementary facts: ' . $complements;
        array_push($this->graph, ...$result->lines);
        $counts = " searched={$result->expanded} memo_hits={$result->memoHits} tried={$result->generated}";
        if ($result->status === 'solved') {
            $this->graph[] =
                'result: solved levels='
                . count($result->layers)
                . ' length='
                . count($result->plan)
                . ' cost='
                . planCost($p, $result->plan)
                . $counts;
            foreach ($result->layers as $i => $layer)
                $this->graph[] = headed('layer ' . ($i + 1) . ':', array_map(fn($n) => actionText(
                    $p->actions[$n],
                ), $layer));
        } else
            $this->graph[] = 'result: FAIL (' . $result->status . ')' . $counts;
    }

    private function profileReport(object $p, Heuristics $e, string $tag, array $plan): void
    {
        $state = $p->initial;
        $remaining = planCost($p, $plan);
        $overestimates = array_fill_keys(HEURISTICS, 0);
        $this->plans[] = "-- profile ($tag) --";
        for ($i = 0; $i <= count($plan); ++$i) {
            $values = $e->values($state);
            $this->plans[] = "  $i: h*=$remaining " . heuristicText($values);
            foreach ($values as $name => $value)
                if ($value === null || $value > $remaining)
                    ++$overestimates[$name];
            if ($i < count($plan)) {
                $a = $p->actions[$plan[$i]];
                $state = applyAction($a, $state);
                $remaining -= $a->cost;
            }
        }
        $parts = [];
        foreach (HEURISTICS as $name)
            $parts[] = $name . '=' . $overestimates[$name];
        $this->plans[] = 'overestimates: ' . implode(' ', $parts);
        $this->plans[] = "-- causal links ($tag) --";
        $suppliers = [];
        foreach ($plan as $i => $n) {
            $a = $p->actions[$n];
            $links = [];
            foreach (sortedKeys($a->pre) as $f)
                $links[] = notation($p->facts[$f]) . '<-' . ($suppliers[$f] ?? 0);
            $this->plans[] = headed('  ' . ($i + 1) . ' ' . actionText($a) . ':', $links);
            foreach ($a->add as $f => $unused)
                $suppliers[$f] = $i + 1;
        }
        $links = [];
        foreach (sortedKeys($p->goal) as $f)
            $links[] = notation($p->facts[$f]) . '<-' . ($suppliers[$f] ?? 0);
        $this->plans[] = headed('  goal:', $links);
    }

    private function summarize(object $p, array $results, ?int $proof): void
    {
        $solved = array_values(array_filter($results, fn($r) => $r->status === 'solved'));
        $best = $solved ? min(array_map(fn($r) => planCost($p, $r->plan), $solved)) : null;
        if ($proof !== null)
            $optimal = (string) planCost($p, $results[$proof]->plan);
        elseif (array_any($results, fn($r) => in_array(
            $r->status,
            ['unreachable goal', 'dead end', 'exhausted', 'unreachable'],
            true,
        )))
            $optimal = 'none';
        else
            $optimal = 'unknown';
        $this->summaries[$p->name] = ['solved' => count($solved), 'best' => $best, 'optimal' => $optimal];
        $pairs = [...$this->settings['runs'], ['graphplan', 'none']];
        foreach ($results as $i => $r) {
            $this->totals[$i]['expanded'] += $r->expanded;
            $this->totals[$i]['generated'] += $r->generated;
            $length = $cost = '-';
            if ($r->status === 'solved') {
                $length = count($r->plan);
                $cost = planCost($p, $r->plan);
                ++$this->totals[$i]['solved'];
                $this->totals[$i]['best'] += (int) ($cost === $best);
            }
            [$algorithm, $heuristic] = $pairs[$i];
            $this->comparison[] = implode(',', [
                $p->name,
                $algorithm,
                $heuristic,
                $length,
                $cost,
                $r->expanded,
                $r->generated,
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function solveProblem(object $source): void
    {
        validateProblem($this->domain, $source);
        $p = ground($this->domain, $source);
        $this->problems[$p->name] = $p;
        $this->groundingReport($p);
        $this->plans[] = $this->graph[] = $this->validation[] = "== problem {$p->name} ==";
        $results = $earlier = [];
        $proof = null;
        if ($p->unreachable) {
            $this->plans[] = 'initial h: unreachable goal';
            $e = null;
            $landmarks = [];
        } else {
            $e = new Heuristics($p);
            $this->evaluators[$p->name] = $e;
            $landmarks = $this->initialReport($p, $e);
        }
        foreach ($this->settings['runs'] as $i => [$algorithm, $heuristic]) {
            $r = $p->unreachable
                ? searchResult('unreachable goal')
                : runSearch(
                    $p,
                    $p->initial,
                    $algorithm,
                    $heuristic,
                    $this->settings['budget'],
                    $this->settings['weight'],
                    $e,
                );
            $results[] = $r;
            $this->resultReport($p, $this->tags[$i], $r, $landmarks, $earlier);
            if (
                $proof === null
                && (
                    $algorithm === 'ucs'
                    && $heuristic === 'none'
                    || $algorithm === 'astar'
                    && $heuristic === 'hmax'
                )
                && $r->status === 'solved'
            )
                $proof = $i;
        }
        $complements = 0;
        if ($p->unreachable)
            $graph = searchResult('unreachable goal');
        else {
            [$actions, $initial, $complements] = transformNegatives($p);
            $graph = new PlanningGraph($actions, $initial, $p->goal, $this->settings['graphplan'])->run();
        }
        $results[] = $graph;
        $this->resultReport($p, 'graphplan', $graph, $landmarks, $earlier);
        $this->graphReport($p, $graph, $complements);
        if ($proof !== null)
            $this->profileReport($p, $e, $this->tags[$proof], $results[$proof]->plan);
        $this->summarize($p, $results, $proof);
        $this->plans[] = $this->graph[] = $this->validation[] = '';
    }

    private function mappedSteps(object $p, array $steps): array
    {
        return array_map(fn($step) => $p->actionNumbers[notation($step)], $steps);
    }

    private function repair(object $p, object $candidate, object $checked): void
    {
        if ($p->unreachable) {
            $this->validation[] = '  repair: FAIL (unreachable goal)';
            return;
        }
        $prefix = $this->mappedSteps($p, array_slice($candidate->steps, 0, $checked->correct));
        $state = $p->initial;
        foreach ($prefix as $n)
            $state = applyAction($p->actions[$n], $state);
        [$algorithm, $heuristic] = $this->settings['repair'];
        $r = runSearch(
            $p,
            $state,
            $algorithm,
            $heuristic,
            $this->settings['budget'],
            $this->settings['weight'],
            $this->evaluators[$p->name],
        );
        if ($r->status !== 'solved') {
            $this->validation[] = '  repair: FAIL (' . $r->status . ')';
            return;
        }
        $repaired = [...$prefix, ...$r->plan];
        $v = validateSteps($this->domain, $p->source, planSteps($p, $repaired));
        $this->validation[] =
            '  repair: kept=' . count($prefix) . ' added=' . count($r->plan) . ' ' . verdict($v);
        foreach ($repaired as $i => $n)
            $this->validation[] = '    ' . ($i + 1) . ' ' . actionText($p->actions[$n]);
    }

    private function candidateReport(): void
    {
        $this->validation[] = '== candidates ==';
        foreach ($this->candidates as $candidate) {
            $p = $this->problems[$candidate->problem];
            $checked = validateSteps($this->domain, $p->source, $candidate->steps);
            $heading = "candidate {$candidate->number} {$candidate->problem} {$candidate->label}: ";
            if ($checked->status === 'valid') {
                ++$this->validCandidates;
                $this->validation[] = $heading . verdict($checked);
                $mapped = $this->mappedSteps($p, $candidate->steps);
                $improved = improve($p, $mapped);
                $best = $this->summaries[$p->name]['best'] ?? '-';
                $this->validation[] =
                    '  improved: length='
                    . count($improved)
                    . ' cost='
                    . planCost($p, $improved)
                    . ' removed='
                    . (count($mapped) - count($improved))
                    . " best known=$best";
            } else {
                $this->validation[] = $heading . $checked->status;
                foreach ($checked->messages as $message)
                    $this->validation[] = '  ' . $message;
                $this->repair($p, $candidate, $checked);
            }
        }
        array_push(
            $this->validation,
            '',
            '== summary ==',
            "plans: {$this->validatedPlans} valid: {$this->validPlans}",
            'candidates: ' . count($this->candidates) . " valid: {$this->validCandidates}",
        );
    }

    public function run(): void
    {
        $this->domainReport();
        foreach ($this->sources as $source)
            $this->solveProblem($source);
        $this->plans[] = '== summary ==';
        foreach ($this->summaries as $name => $s)
            $this->plans[] =
                "$name: solved={$s['solved']}/"
                . count($this->tags)
                . ' best='
                . ($s['best'] ?? '-')
                . " optimal={$s['optimal']}";
        foreach ($this->tags as $i => $tag) {
            $t = $this->totals[$i];
            $this->plans[] = "$tag: solved={$t['solved']} best={$t['best']} expanded={$t['expanded']} generated={$t['generated']}";
        }
        $this->candidateReport();
        if (!is_dir('output'))
            mkdir('output');
        foreach ([
            'grounding.txt' => $this->grounding,
            'plans.txt' => $this->plans,
            'graphplan.txt' => $this->graph,
            'validation.txt' => $this->validation,
            'comparison.csv' => $this->comparison,
        ] as $name => $lines)
            file_put_contents('output/' . $name, implode("\n", $lines) . "\n");
    }
}

new Planner()->run();

function expressions(string $text): array
{
    $text = preg_replace('/;[^\n]*/', '', $text);
    preg_match_all('/\(|\)|[^ ()\n]+/', $text, $matches);
    $tokens = $matches[0];
    $i = 0;
    $read = function () use (&$read, &$i, $tokens): array|string {
        $token = $tokens[$i++];
        if ($token !== '(')
            return $token;
        $list = [];
        while ($tokens[$i] !== ')')
            $list[] = $read();
        ++$i;
        return $list;
    };
    $roots = [];
    while ($i < count($tokens))
        $roots[] = $read();
    return $roots;
}

function typedList(array $words): array
{
    $result = $pending = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i < count($words);) {
        if ($words[$i] === '-') {
            foreach ($pending as $name)
                $result[] = [$name, $words[$i + 1]];
            $pending = [];
            $i += 2;
        } else
            $pending[] = $words[$i++];
    }
    foreach ($pending as $name)
        $result[] = [$name, 'object'];
    return $result;
}

function atom(array $expression): array
{
    return [$expression[0], array_slice($expression, 1)];
}

function elements(array $expression, bool $empty = true): array
{
    $conjunction = $expression[0] === 'and' && array_all(array_slice($expression, 1), is_array(...));
    return $conjunction && ($empty || count($expression) > 1) ? array_slice($expression, 1) : [$expression];
}

function literal(array $expression): array
{
    return (
        $expression[0] === 'not' && count($expression) === 2 && is_array($expression[1])
            ? [false, atom($expression[1])]
            : [true, atom($expression)]
    );
}

function readDomain(string $text): object
{
    $e = expressions($text)[0];
    $d = (object) [
        'name' => $e[1][1],
        'parents' => ['object' => null],
        'typeOrder' => ['object'],
        'predicates' => [],
        'actions' => [],
    ];
    foreach (array_slice($e, 2) as $s) {
        if ($s[0] === ':types') {
            foreach (array_slice($s, 1) as $name)
                if ($name !== '-' && !array_key_exists($name, $d->parents)) {
                    $d->parents[$name] = 'object';
                    $d->typeOrder[] = $name;
                }
            foreach (typedList(array_slice($s, 1)) as [$name, $parent])
                $d->parents[$name] = $parent;
        } elseif ($s[0] === ':predicates')
            foreach (array_slice($s, 1) as $p)
                $d->predicates[$p[0]] = array_column(typedList(array_slice($p, 1)), 1);
        elseif ($s[0] === ':action') {
            $fields = [];
            for ($i = 2; $i < count($s); $i += 2)
                $fields[$s[$i]] = $s[$i + 1];
            $condition = isset($fields[':precondition'])
                ? array_map(literal(...), elements($fields[':precondition']))
                : [];
            $effects = [];
            $cost = 1;
            foreach (elements($fields[':effect'], false) as $item) {
                if ($item[0] === 'increase' && count($item) === 3 && $item[1] === ['total-cost'])
                    $cost = (int) $item[2];
                else
                    $effects[] = literal($item);
            }
            $d->actions[] = (object) [
                'name' => $s[1],
                'parameters' => typedList($fields[':parameters']),
                'condition' => $condition,
                'effects' => $effects,
                'cost' => $cost,
            ];
        }
    }
    return $d;
}

function readProblems(string $text): array
{
    $problems = [];
    foreach (expressions($text) as $e) {
        $sections = [];
        foreach (array_slice($e, 2) as $s)
            $sections[$s[0]] = array_slice($s, 1);
        $objects = [];
        foreach (typedList($sections[':objects']) as [$name, $kind])
            $objects[$name] = $kind;
        $problems[] = (object) [
            'name' => $e[1][1],
            'objects' => $objects,
            'initial' => array_map(atom(...), $sections[':init']),
            'goals' => array_map(atom(...), elements($sections[':goal'][0], false)),
        ];
    }
    return $problems;
}

<?php

function applicable(object $a, array $state): bool
{
    return subset($a->pre, $state) && !array_intersect_key($a->neg, $state);
}

function applyAction(object $a, array $state): array
{
    return array_diff_key($state, $a->delete) + $a->add;
}

function searchResult(string $status, int $expanded = 0, int $generated = 0, array $plan = []): object
{
    return (object) [
        'status' => $status,
        'expanded' => $expanded,
        'generated' => $generated,
        'plan' => $plan,
    ];
}

function stateKey(array $state): string
{
    return implode(',', sortedKeys($state));
}

function runSearch(
    object $problem,
    array $start,
    string $algorithm,
    string $heuristic,
    int $budget,
    int $weight,
    Heuristics $evaluator,
): object {
    $initialH = $evaluator->value($heuristic, $start);
    if ($initialH === null)
        return searchResult('dead end');
    $expanded = $generated = 0;
    if ($algorithm === 'ehc') {
        $current = $start;
        $plan = [];
        $hc = $initialH;
        while (!subset($problem->goal, $current)) {
            $queue = [[$current, []]];
            $visited = [stateKey($current) => true];
            $improved = false;
            for ($head = 0; $head < count($queue) && !$improved; ++$head) {
                [$state, $prefix] = $queue[$head];
                if ($expanded === $budget)
                    return searchResult('budget', $expanded, $generated);
                ++$expanded;
                foreach ($evaluator->helpful($state) as $number) {
                    $next = applyAction($problem->actions[$number], $state);
                    ++$generated;
                    $key = stateKey($next);
                    if (isset($visited[$key]))
                        continue;
                    $visited[$key] = true;
                    $h = $evaluator->value($heuristic, $next);
                    if ($h === null)
                        continue;
                    $path = [...$prefix, $number];
                    if ($h < $hc) {
                        array_push($plan, ...$path);
                        $current = $next;
                        $hc = $h;
                        $improved = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    $queue[] = [$next, $path];
                }
            }
            if (!$improved)
                return searchResult('stuck', $expanded, $generated);
        }
        return searchResult('solved', $expanded, $generated, $plan);
    }
    $priority = fn($g, $d, $h) => match ($algorithm) {
        'bfs' => $d,
        'ucs' => $g,
        'gbfs' => $h,
        'wastar' => $g + ($weight * $h),
        default => $g + $h,
    };
    $first = (object) ['state' => $start, 'g' => 0, 'depth' => 0, 'parent' => null, 'action' => null];
    $queue = new SplPriorityQueue();
    $queue->setExtractFlags(SplPriorityQueue::EXTR_DATA);
    $queue->insert($first, [-$priority(0, 0, $initialH), -$initialH, 0]);
    $best = [stateKey($start) => 0];
    $serial = 1;
    $reopen = in_array($algorithm, ['ucs', 'astar', 'wastar'], true);
    while (!$queue->isEmpty()) {
        $node = $queue->extract();
        if ($reopen && $node->g > $best[stateKey($node->state)])
            continue;
        if (subset($problem->goal, $node->state)) {
            $plan = [];
            while ($node->parent !== null) {
                $plan[] = $node->action;
                $node = $node->parent;
            }
            return searchResult('solved', $expanded, $generated, array_reverse($plan));
        }
        if ($expanded === $budget)
            return searchResult('budget', $expanded, $generated);
        ++$expanded;
        foreach ($problem->actions as $a)
            if (applicable($a, $node->state)) {
                $state = applyAction($a, $node->state);
                ++$generated;
                $g = $node->g + $a->cost;
                $key = stateKey($state);
                if (isset($best[$key]) && (!$reopen || $best[$key] <= $g))
                    continue;
                $best[$key] = $g;
                $h = $evaluator->value($heuristic, $state);
                if ($h === null)
                    continue;
                $child = (object) [
                    'state' => $state,
                    'g' => $g,
                    'depth' => $node->depth + 1,
                    'parent' => $node,
                    'action' => $a->number,
                ];
                $queue->insert($child, [-$priority($g, $child->depth, $h), -$h, -$serial++]);
            }
    }
    return searchResult('exhausted', $expanded, $generated);
}
